rites.name: Tirasanoma
rites.text: Tirasanoma is the concept of a resonant hush that gathers when the first roots of Corentium condense, a moment the Singing holds without any date. In the Age of Strangers, outsiders learned to anchor their trade-lines to its pulse, binding passing wealth to the slow growth of the world.

rites.name: Bruranon
rites.text: Bruranon is an invented concept of the Corentium omniverse, a principle of flame and binding that the orders of the Holy Age treated as the key to the doors between worlds. Its devotees held that every trial in the Courts was a measure of how much of it a soul could hold without burning away.

rites.name: Larum
rites.text: Larum is a concept of Corentium, the thread of Seeding that marks the hour the makers plant the Weave and quiet powers sleep. In the Holy Age of flame, temples and orders, it is remembered as the quiet bell that settled the sleeping forces of the world.

rites.name: Naunum
rites.text: Naunum is the concept of a sealed outcome in Corentium's Three Futures, a single branch of ending that the Library of the Holy Age shelves beside its rivals. Its power is the quiet weight of a path not taken, felt most strongly in the temples where its orders keep the flame burning.

rites.name: Veneimora
rites.text: Veneimora is a concept in Corentium's Three Futures, a branching ending that the Library shelves beside every other outcome. In the Holy Age of flame and temple orders, it is invoked as the shape a single choice might take when all paths are weighed at once.
